title: Closed return compatibility of the canonical Weil-pullback fibre comparison
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(k_0,k)$ with $k_0$ finite and $k$ its algebraic closure [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a morphism of separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, with geometric base change $f:X\to Y$. Let $z$ be a closed point of $X_0$ and assume $x=f_0(z)$ is closed in $Y_0$. Choose embeddings $\iota_z:\kappa(z)\to k$ and $\iota_x:\kappa(x)\to k$ over $k_0$ whose induced geometric lifts satisfy $\bar z\mathbin{;}f=\bar x$. For the constructible Weil hearts [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex, def-weil-constructible-heart], actual inverse image [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], and degree-zero rational point fibres [lem-wf-rational-stalk-exact], define $c_{f,z}:f^*\mathbin{;}\operatorname{Fib}_{\bar z}\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Fib}_{\bar x}$ naturally on the Weil heart by applying the point fibre and coefficient $H^0$ to the inverse normalized pullback compositor for $\bar z\mathbin{;}f$, followed by equality transport to $\bar x$. This is a concrete isomorphism. For every constructible $\Omega$-Weil sheaf $\mathcal F$, its component satisfies
$$F_{z,f^*\mathcal F}\mathbin{;}c_{f,z,\mathcal F}=c_{f,z,\mathcal F}\mathbin{;}F_{x,\mathcal F}^{[\kappa(z):\kappa(x)]},$$
where the operators are the recorded geometric closed Frobenius [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. The assertion is only this square for the specified comparison; it does not assert closedness of the image, residue-field cardinalities, heart preservation or an eigenvalue formula.

proof.text: Choose a common finite coefficient field representing the Weil object and its structure and inverse, enlarging until the inverse equations hold. Apply [lem-fd-rational-pullback-fibre-comparison] and its simultaneous normalized comparison system. Its component is the point fibre of the inverse normalized compositor; applying coefficient H^0 gives the concrete comparison in the statement.

Let d=[κ(x):k_0] and e=[κ(z):κ(x)]. Both are positive and finite by [lem-kun-closed-point-field]; the residue-field tower law gives [κ(z):k_0]=de. The chosen geometric lifts return after de steps. Apply [lem-fd-pullback-weil-return-square] at de to obtain c R_z(de)=R_x(de)c. Its beta equation identifies the Weil pullback structure and all its iterates.

Apply [lem-fd-rational-return-block-power] at x with block length d and e blocks, identifying R_x(de) with R_x(d)^e. Thus the finite-stage comparison intertwines the closed return at z with the e-th power of the closed return at x.

The scalar square of [lem-fd-rational-pullback-fibre-comparison], together with [lem-fd-local-frobenius-coefficient-extension], identifies the equation at every larger coefficient field, including identity extensions and towers. The prescribed common-stage Hom classes therefore give the same equation. Normalization identifies the resulting maps with the recorded closed local operators. Apply coefficient H^0; its functoriality preserves composition and powers, giving the displayed square for the concrete comparison.

theorem fdWeilPullbackFibreReturn
    [IsSeparated X₀.hom] [IsSeparated Y₀.hom] (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    (z : {z : X₀.left // z ∈ closedPoints X₀.left})
    (hx : f₀.left.base z.val ∈ closedPoints Y₀.left)
    (ιz : X₀.left.residueField z.val →+* D.k)
    (hz : ιz.comp (X₀.hom.residueFieldAlgebraMap z.val) = algebraMap D.k₀ D.k)
    (ιx : Y₀.left.residueField (f₀.left.base z.val) →+* D.k)
    (hxι : ιx.comp (Y₀.hom.residueFieldAlgebraMap (f₀.left.base z.val)) =
      algebraMap D.k₀ D.k)
    (h : localClosedPoint D X₀ z ιz hz ≫ zlFiberMap D f₀ =
      localClosedPoint D Y₀ ⟨f₀.left.base z.val, hx⟩ ιx hxι)
    (F : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D c.l c.different Y₀ c.Qbar) :
    wfSheafClosedFrobenius c.l c.Qbar D c.different X₀
        ((zlWeilPull D c.l c.different c.Qbar f₀).obj F) z ιz hz ≫
      (fdWeilPullbackFibreComparison D c X₀ Y₀ f₀
        (localClosedPoint D X₀ z ιz hz)
        (localClosedPoint D Y₀ ⟨f₀.left.base z.val, hx⟩ ιx hxι) h).hom.app F =
    (fdWeilPullbackFibreComparison D c X₀ Y₀ f₀
      (localClosedPoint D X₀ z ιz hz)
      (localClosedPoint D Y₀ ⟨f₀.left.base z.val, hx⟩ ιx hxι) h).hom.app F ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom
        ((wfSheafClosedFrobenius c.l c.Qbar D c.different Y₀ F
          ⟨f₀.left.base z.val, hx⟩ ιx hxι).hom ^ f₀.left.residueDegree z.val)
